in_marathi.name: Ramchandra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramchandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rama is a name of the Hindu god Vishnu, who is considered an avatar of the supreme god, Brahma. Rama is the embodiment of duty, morality, and righteousness.
